name: Flourish
intro: This is where I cook properly. Whole foods, and a bit more prep.

fl-table.label: Lay the Table
fl-table.tool_text: I can't lay the table with a full recipe yet. Soon. Keep looking around and I'll leave you ideas.

fl-eggs.label: The eggs
fl-eggs.moment: From the farm up the road. The hens are laying well this week.
moments: Brown eggs, mostly. The hens don't take requests.
I keep them out of the fridge. Hard to say why.

fl-greens.label: The greens
fl-greens.moment: Kale and parsley, picked twenty minutes ago.

fl-range.label: The range
fl-range.moment: I light it first thing and it stays lit all day. The big pan lives on it.

fl-dresser.label: The dresser
fl-dresser.moment: Lentils, chickpeas, oats and seeds. Keep these jars full and there's always a good meal.
moments: I top the jars up on the first of the month.

fl-trug.label: The trug
fl-trug.moment: Straight out of the beds. Knock the soil off, but don't wash them until you need them.

fl-herbs.label: The herbs
fl-herbs.ref: the herbs on the window ledge
fl-herbs.moment: Rosemary, thyme and mint. They like the sun on this ledge.

fl-phonograph.label: The phonograph
fl-phonograph.moment: Wind the handle and it plays: Grieg, Vivaldi or Dvořák, depending on the hour.
fl-phonograph.moment_stop: Needle up. That'll do for now.
fl-phonograph.moment_quiet: Give the handle a few turns. Turn the sound on, by the bell, and you'll hear it.

fl-window.label: The sea
fl-window.moment: The same bay you see from Cuddlecore, from the other side of the Inn.
moments: The bay looks different from this side. Same water, though.
I wash this window more than the others. Don't ask me why.

fl-back-door.label: The garden door
fl-back-door.closed: The kitchen garden's for another day. Breathe in, though. That's the rosemary.

atoms.title: Eggs baked on a pan of greens
atoms.hook: Eggs baked into a pan of garlicky greens.
atoms.method_short: Wilt kale or spinach with garlic, crack two eggs into it and put the lid on for four minutes.

seed.name: Eggs baked on garlicky greens
seed.why: Protein and greens in one pan, for breakfast or lunch.

atoms.body: Wilt kale or spinach with garlic, crack two eggs into it and put the lid on for four minutes.

atoms.title: Oats with a spoon of seeds
atoms.hook: Porridge with pumpkin, sunflower and flax seeds stirred in.
atoms.method_short: Your usual porridge or overnight oats, with pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and ground flax stirred in.

seed.name: Seeded porridge with berries
seed.why: Seeds add protein, fibre and good fats, so the bowl lasts longer.

atoms.body: Your usual porridge or overnight oats, with pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and ground flax stirred in.

atoms.title: Red lentil and carrot soup
atoms.hook: Red lentils, carrot and cumin, cooked until they fall apart.
atoms.method_short: Onion and grated carrot, a cup of red lentils, cumin and stock. Twenty minutes, then a squeeze of lemon.

seed.name: Red lentil and carrot soup
seed.why: Pulses and vegetables in a pot that costs very little.

atoms.body: Onion and grated carrot, a cup of red lentils, cumin and stock. Twenty minutes, then a squeeze of lemon.

atoms.title: Roast beetroot and lentil salad
atoms.hook: Roast beetroot, lentils, rocket and feta. Better the next day.
atoms.method_short: Roast beetroot tossed with green lentils, rocket, feta and a mustardy dressing. Better the next day.

seed.name: Roast beetroot, lentil and feta salad
seed.why: Earthy, filling and full of colour.

atoms.body: Roast beetroot tossed with green lentils, rocket, feta and a mustardy dressing. Better the next day.

atoms.title: Whatever's-in-the-trug frittata
atoms.hook: Whatever vegetables you have, set in eggs under the grill.
atoms.method_short: Whatever vegetables you have, six beaten eggs and a little cheese, set gently and finished under the grill.

seed.name: Garden vegetable frittata
seed.why: It uses up the vegetable drawer, and cold slices make lunch.

atoms.body: Whatever vegetables you have, six beaten eggs and a little cheese, set gently and finished under the grill.

atoms.title: A Sunday cook-up for the week
atoms.hook: Grains, roast vegetables and boiled eggs, cooked once for the week.
atoms.method_short: On Sunday, cook a pot of grains, a tray of roast vegetables and some boiled eggs. All week, meals are just putting things together.

seed.name: Sunday meal prep: grains, roast vegetables and eggs
seed.why: An hour once a week means proper food on busy days.

atoms.body: On Sunday, cook a pot of grains, a tray of roast vegetables and some boiled eggs. All week, meals are just putting things together.

atoms.title: Salmon, greens and new potatoes on one tray
atoms.hook: Salmon, green beans and new potatoes on one tray, with lemon.
atoms.method_short: New potatoes roasted for twenty minutes, then salmon and green beans on top for twelve more. Lemon over everything.

seed.name: Salmon and green bean tray bake
seed.why: A whole-food dinner with one tray to wash.

atoms.body: New potatoes roasted for twenty minutes, then salmon and green beans on top for twelve more. Lemon over everything.

atoms.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
atoms.hook: Chickpeas and spinach in a spiced tomato sauce, with rice.
atoms.method_short: Onion, garlic, ginger and curry spices, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a big handful of spinach. Rice on the side.

seed.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
seed.why: Pulses, greens and warmth for a cold evening.

atoms.body: Onion, garlic, ginger and curry spices, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a big handful of spinach. Rice on the side.

atoms.title: A grain bowl with roast vegetables
atoms.hook: Quinoa, roast vegetables and chickpeas with a lemony tahini dressing.
atoms.method_short: Quinoa or brown rice, roast vegetables, a few leaves and a lemony tahini dressing. Make extra for tomorrow.

seed.name: Roast vegetable grain bowl with tahini
seed.why: A balanced lunch that keeps well.

atoms.body: Quinoa or brown rice, roast vegetables, a few leaves and a lemony tahini dressing. Make extra for tomorrow.

atoms.title: Tabbouleh with lots of parsley
atoms.hook: Mostly parsley and mint, with a little bulgur, tomato and lemon.
atoms.method_short: Mostly parsley and mint, a little bulgur, tomato, lemon and olive oil.

seed.name: Parsley and mint tabbouleh
seed.why: A whole-food salad that's mostly herbs.

atoms.body: Mostly parsley and mint, a little bulgur, tomato, lemon and olive oil.

atoms.title: A big pot of vegetable soup
atoms.hook: Whatever vegetables need using, slowly simmered into soup.
atoms.method_short: Onion, carrot and celery softened in butter, then whatever vegetables need using and stock to cover. Let it tick over while you get on with something else.

seed.name: Big-batch vegetable soup
seed.why: A week of lunches from the vegetable drawer.

atoms.body: Onion, carrot and celery softened in butter, then whatever vegetables need using and stock to cover. Let it tick over while you get on with something else.

atoms.title: Stock from scraps
atoms.hook: Vegetable scraps from a freezer bag, simmered into stock.
atoms.method_short: Keep onion ends, carrot peel and herb stalks in a freezer bag. When it's full, cover with water and simmer for an hour.

seed.name: Vegetable stock from scraps
seed.why: Free stock, and nothing wasted.

atoms.body: Keep onion ends, carrot peel and herb stalks in a freezer bag. When it's full, cover with water and simmer for an hour.

atoms.title: Green herb salt
atoms.hook: Soft herbs chopped with flaky salt until bright green.
atoms.method_short: Chop a big handful of soft herbs with flaky salt until it's bright green. A pinch wakes up eggs, rice, anything plain.

seed.name: Green herb salt
seed.why: A jar of it makes plain food taste of the garden.

atoms.body: Chop a big handful of soft herbs with flaky salt until it's bright green. A pinch wakes up eggs, rice, anything plain.

atoms.title: Gentle knife skills: the claw
atoms.hook: The claw grip, practised on a chopped salad.
atoms.method_short: Curl your fingertips under so the blade rides against your knuckles. Slow is fine.

seed.name: Chopped salad with a lemon dressing
seed.why: Good knife practice that ends in lunch.

atoms.body: Curl your fingertips under so the blade rides against your knuckles. Slow is fine.

atoms.title: Why a bit of protein at breakfast helps
atoms.hook: Why an egg or some seeds at breakfast keeps you full for longer.
atoms.method_short: Protein and fibre take longer to digest than sugar and white bread, so an egg or a spoon of seeds keeps you full for longer.

seed.name: Spinach and feta omelette
seed.why: A quick breakfast with protein in it.

atoms.body: Protein and fibre take longer to digest than sugar and white bread, so an egg or a spoon of seeds keeps you full for longer.

atoms.title: Why lots of colours on the plate
atoms.hook: A few colours on the plate covers more ground, with no counting.
atoms.method_short: Different coloured vegetables bring different things: beta-carotene in carrots, folate in dark greens. A few colours covers more ground, with no counting.

seed.name: Rainbow vegetable tray bake
seed.why: Five colours on one tray.

atoms.body: Different coloured vegetables bring different things: beta-carotene in carrots, folate in dark greens. A few colours covers more ground, with no counting.

atoms.title: Kale, the cottage-garden green
atoms.hook: Kale stands through frost, and a cold snap makes it sweeter.
atoms.method_short: Cottage gardeners grew kale because it stands through frost and keeps cropping. A cold snap makes the leaves a little sweeter.

seed.name: Kale and white bean stew
seed.why: A winter-garden green in a warm pot.

atoms.body: Cottage gardeners grew kale because it stands through frost and keeps cropping. A cold snap makes the leaves a little sweeter.

atoms.title: What a squeeze of lemon does
atoms.hook: A squeeze of lemon at the end makes flat food taste brighter.
atoms.method_short: Acid makes flavours taste brighter, which is why a squeeze of lemon can rescue a flat soup. Add it at the end, off the heat.

seed.name: Lemon and thyme roast chicken
seed.why: Lemon doing its job in a proper dinner.

atoms.body: Acid makes flavours taste brighter, which is why a squeeze of lemon can rescue a flat soup. Add it at the end, off the heat.

atoms.title: Asparagus with soft eggs and herbs
atoms.hook: Asparagus with soft-boiled eggs to dip, and chives on top.
atoms.method_short: Boil the eggs for six minutes. Steam the asparagus for three. Dip the spears into the eggs, with chives and lemon.

seed.name: Asparagus with soft eggs and chives
seed.why: Spring greens and eggs make a proper breakfast or lunch.

atoms.body: Boil the eggs for six minutes. Steam the asparagus for three. Dip the spears into the eggs, with chives and lemon.

atoms.title: Sweetcorn fritters with tomato salsa
atoms.hook: Sweetcorn fritters, crisp at the edges, with a fresh tomato salsa.
atoms.method_short: Mix sweetcorn with egg, a little flour and coriander, and fry spoonfuls until golden. Serve with chopped tomato and lime.

seed.name: Sweetcorn fritters with tomato salsa
seed.why: Summer sweetcorn, in a proper lunch.

atoms.body: Mix sweetcorn with egg, a little flour and coriander, and fry spoonfuls until golden. Serve with chopped tomato and lime.

atoms.title: Roast kūmara and lentil salad
atoms.hook: Roast kūmara with lentils, spinach and a lemony tahini dressing.
atoms.method_short: Roast cubed kūmara and red onion until soft. Toss with cooked lentils, spinach and tahini thinned with lemon.

seed.name: Roast kūmara, lentil and spinach salad
seed.why: Autumn kūmara with pulses, enough for a meal.

atoms.body: Roast cubed kūmara and red onion until soft. Toss with cooked lentils, spinach and tahini thinned with lemon.

atoms.title: Silverbeet and feta pie
atoms.hook: Silverbeet, feta and egg in crisp filo, sliced warm.
atoms.method_short: Wilt silverbeet with onion, mix with feta and egg, and bake between buttered layers of filo until golden.

seed.name: Silverbeet and feta filo pie
seed.why: Silverbeet grows right through winter, and this uses a whole bunch.

atoms.body: Wilt silverbeet with onion, mix with feta and egg, and bake between buttered layers of filo until golden.

atoms.title: Whitebait fritters
atoms.hook: Whitebait in a light egg batter, fried in small golden fritters.
atoms.method_short: Mix whitebait with beaten eggs and a spoonful of flour. Fry small spoonfuls in butter until golden, and finish with lemon.

seed.name: Whitebait fritters with lemon
seed.why: Whitebait is only in the shops for a few weeks in spring.

atoms.body: Mix whitebait with beaten eggs and a spoonful of flour. Fry small spoonfuls in butter until golden, and finish with lemon.

atoms.title: Kūmara wedges with lime yoghurt
atoms.hook: Kūmara wedges roasted crisp, with lime yoghurt.
atoms.method_short: Cut kūmara into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast until crisp at the edges. Stir lime zest and juice into yoghurt for dipping.

seed.name: Kūmara wedges with lime yoghurt
seed.why: Kūmara roasts sweet and crisp, and lime keeps the yoghurt sharp.

atoms.body: Cut kūmara into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast until crisp at the edges. Stir lime zest and juice into yoghurt for dipping.
